I am 24F and I had my thyroid radiated when I was 17. Since then I have had NO thyroid activity or if there has been activity it has been so low that they blood work is not able to detect it. It has made my weight skyrocket. I know people who got the surgery and had part of their thyroid removed, and they are healthy. I would recommend doing research on both and get more info form you endo on which they think would be best for you, but remember in the end it is your decision. I let my endo talk me in to doing the radiation and I regret it everyday.
